messages:
anya: Quick design request for the webinar + benchmark launch. Need a small asset suite for paid social, webinar page, and the sales one-pager. Deliverables: hero for social (3 CTA variants), benchmark comparison matrix (printable 2-up slide), latency vs cost sparkline diagram, routing map (simple flow showing landing -> nurture -> demo), and slide deck master with brand-safe title slide. Also need export presets + file-naming conventions and a QA checklist for brand compliance + accessibility. Deadline: draft comps by Fri EOD, final exports Tue EOD.
dante: OK. Can you confirm the number of CTA variants and languages? Also: any speaker photos or screenshots to include?
anya: CTA variants: Watch webinar / Read benchmark / Request demo. Languages: EN + DE (priority) + FR (if time). No screenshots in the public hero — we want abstract geometry. Speaker photos only for the slide deck and sales one-pager (two portraits).
claire: Messaging: keep headlines focused on "inference economics" and "production-grade latency". I'll supply 2 headline options per CTA and a 1-line descriptor. Will paste copy by Thu. Also need UTM templates for each CTA.
vikram: For lead routing, we need the CTA clicks to map to our tracking: utm_source=paid_social, utm_campaign=webinar_bench_v1, utm_content=cta_variant. Also add data-layer event name: redwood.cta_click with property cta_variant. Landing form should include hidden field route_source=paid_social. For Marketo mapping, pass form field mktoCampaignId=50123.
dante: good. Specs I'll push into the Figma file. Quick question on file naming: prefer lowercase dashes and include date/version?
anya: Yes: yyyyMMdd_assettype_variant_v{1}. Example: 20260701_socialhero_watch-v1.png. Keep versions.
dante: Cool. I'll mock export presets as default in a codeblock in figma.
claire: Also, can design produce a subtle GIF variant for social hero (looping 3-frame) for A/B? Keep it small <800KB.
dante: Yup. We'll do micro-anim (shape translate + opacity) and provide Lottie fallback if needed.
figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/efGH56/redwood-bench-launch-assets — editors: @dante @anya @claire @vikram
dante: Dropping initial layout choices Thu morning. Will include: timeline, matrix-card, and stacked-sparkline.
anya: Brand rules reminder: logo clearspace = 8px, no outer glows, use primary blue for CTAs, accent for cost sparkline. Include org line on slide: "Redwood Inference | Production-grade LLM inference". For DE copy, shorten CTAs if they overflow.
vikram: Accessibility: each image needs alt_text in EN/DE/FR, color contrast > 4.5:1 for text, keyboard-focusable GIFs should be pauseable. Also provide transcript for animated GIF describing motion.
dante: I'll include alt_text tokens in Figma layers (copy_id). Also export a CSV with copy_id, EN, DE, FR, alt_text.
claire: Marketing asks: please bake UTM into social hero export filenames for QA? Eg: 20260701_socialhero_watch_utmsrc-paid.png — maybe overkill but helps audit.
anya: Good idea — do both filename + a small readme in the export package with final UTMs and mapping.
dante: Here's the export spec I'm adding to figma comments:
```
- social hero: 1200x628 px, PNG (sRGB), export @1x, animated GIF 600x314 px max 800KB, 3 frames, loop, no audio
- slide tile: 800x600 px export to PDF and PNG, include org line in footer, bleed not required
- benchmark matrix: 1600x900 px (for printable 2-up), PDF with crop marks, CSV data source attached
- routing map: 1200x600 px SVG + PNG, ensure vector nodes exported as shapes (no flattening)
- fonts: Inter (variable), fallback: system-ui; convert text to outlines only for final PDFs where embedding is problematic
- naming: yyyyMMdd_assetname_variant_language_v{n}.ext
```
vikram: QA checklist (high level) I'll add here so designers can reference:
- logo clearspace adhered
- org line present on slide tiles
- contrast >= 4.5:1
- alt_text present for each language
- filenames include version and language
- UTM template documented in README.txt
- animated GIF < 800KB and pausable
- CSV localization attached
- Marketo form mapping documented

claire: Timeline recap: Thu morning comps, Fri internal review, Mon stakeholder review (sales + growth), Tue final assets & README. If scope slides, we'll deprioritize FR.
dante: Acknowledged. I'll flag if any blocker.
anya: Thanks all. Ping here when comps live. :rocket:
